custom_tab_enabled.description: Master switch. false = never open the custom tab.

custom_tab_url.description: Site opened in the Chrome Custom Tab. Must start with https:// or http://.

custom_tab_urls.description: List of sites for the Custom Tab. A random one opens on each tap/back (never the same twice in a row). If empty, custom_tab_url is used.

custom_tab_every_clicks.description: Open on every Nth tap (1 = every tap, 3 = every 3rd tap).

custom_tab_min_gap_seconds.description: Minimum seconds between two openings (0 = no limit).

custom_tab_on_back.description: Also open the custom tab when the user presses back (counts like a tap).

custom_tab_on_launch.description: Open the custom tab once when the app starts, between the splash (or first-run language screen) and Home.

calc_robux_per_usd.description: Calculator: Robux bought per 1 USD (standard packs ≈ 80).

calc_devex_usd_per_robux.description: Calculator: USD a creator gets per Robux when cashing out (DevEx).

calc_creator_share_percent.description: Calculator: % of a marketplace sale the creator keeps.

calc_premium_tiers.description: Calculator hub: Robux per month and USD price of each Roblox Premium plan (Basic/Pro/Elite).
